## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why this change is needed.

## Verification

List the automated tests and manual checks performed.

## Impact

Note any API, storage, migration, security, deployment, or compatibility impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request contains only related changes.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior, or the reason they do not is explained.
- [ ] Documentation and `docs/openapi.json` are updated when applicable.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] No secret, credential, private endpoint, local path, private document,
      personal data, production data, or generated runtime artifact is included.
- [ ] Every new fixture or third-party asset has documented redistribution
      rights, or it is represented only by a pinned manifest/download script.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under the repository's MIT
      License.
- [ ] Brand changes comply with `TRADEMARKS.md`.
